description.zh: 围绕面板接口、通风、门盖、安装点和内部空间完成结构拆分，并支持五金件、盖板和子组件装配。
description.en: Structural breakdown around panel interfaces, ventilation, doors, covers, mounting points and internal space, with support for hardware, covers and subassembly integration.

description.en: Stamping and forming support for crimp wings, spring contacts, receptacle boxes and conductive connection tabs.

description.zh: 面向储能和电池设备的铜排、盖板、托盘、支架和箱体项目，按连接、绝缘、通风及装配要求协同制造。
description.en: Busbar, cover plate, tray, bracket and enclosure projects for energy-storage and battery equipment, coordinated around connection, insulation, ventilation and assembly requirements.

description.zh: 在项目启动阶段评审材料、成形特征、孔边距离、折弯关系、装配基准和表面要求，形成可执行的制造路径。
description.en: Early review of material, forming features, hole-to-edge relationships, bend geometry, assembly datums and finish requirements to define an executable manufacturing route.

description.zh: 依据图纸和使用环境衔接喷粉、镀层、氧化或拉丝等表面要求，并在包装前确认外观和装配状态。
description.en: Finishing requirements such as powder coating, plating, anodizing or brushing are coordinated to drawings and service conditions, with appearance and assembly status reviewed before packing.

description.zh: 机箱、面板、安装支架、底盘和内部固定件，围绕设备空间、强度和维护方式进行设计协同。
description.en: Chassis, panels, mounting brackets, bases and internal retainers coordinated around equipment space, structural needs and service access.

description.zh: 机架式机箱、通风底盘、接口面板和内部支架，支持设备模块化和维护便利性。

title.zh: 以图纸和确认要求为质量基准
title.en: Quality Anchored to Drawings and Confirmed Requirements

summary.zh: 质量策划从项目资料开始。材料、关键特征、外观、装配关系和检验记录根据图纸及双方确认内容执行，让每个项目拥有清晰的验收边界。
summary.en: Quality planning starts with project information. Materials, critical features, appearance, assembly relationships and inspection records follow drawings and mutually confirmed requirements, creating a clear acceptance basis for each project.

description.zh: 生产、检验和变更沟通围绕已确认版本展开，减少不同版本混用风险。
description.en: Production, inspection and change communication are organized around the confirmed revision to reduce version-mix risks.

description.zh: 根据项目要求确认材料牌号、状态和表面需求，并规划必要的标识与资料。
description.en: Material grade, condition and finish requirements are confirmed per project, with identification and documentation planned where required.

description.zh: 在批量推进前核对关键结构、孔位、折弯、装配和外观要求。
description.en: Critical features, holes, bends, assembly relationships and appearance requirements are reviewed before volume production.

description.zh: 针对冲压、折弯、连接和表面处理节点设置与项目风险相匹配的检查。
description.en: Checks are aligned with project risk across stamping, bending, joining and finishing stages.

description.zh: 包装前复核数量、外观、关键特征、装配状态和项目约定资料。
description.en: Quantity, appearance, critical features, assembly status and agreed project documents are reviewed before packing.

description.zh: 检验记录、材料资料、样件确认和包装标识可根据项目实际要求进行规划与确认。
description.en: Inspection records, material documents, sample approval and packing identification can be planned and confirmed according to actual project requirements.

description.zh: 根据零件表面、形状和运输要求安排防护、标签和交付资料。

title.en: Focused on Custom Hardware and Direct Engineering Communication

overview.zh: 东莞市展益五金制品有限公司专注于定制金属零部件，产品覆盖精密冲压件、钣金机箱、端子触点、插头五金、电源结构件、新能源五金以及支架与散热件。我们以图纸和项目要求为起点，组织工艺评审、生产协同、检验与交付沟通。
overview.en: Dongguan Zhanyi Hardware Products Co., Ltd. focuses on custom metal components across precision stampings, sheet metal enclosures, terminals and contacts, plug hardware, power components, new energy hardware, brackets and heat sinks. Work begins with drawings and project requirements, followed by process review, production coordination, inspection and delivery planning.

positioning.zh: 我们希望成为客户产品团队与制造现场之间清晰、务实的协作接口，在项目前期明确材料、工艺、检查和交付边界，让后续推进更透明。
positioning.en: Our role is to provide a clear, practical interface between customer product teams and manufacturing execution, aligning material, process, inspection and delivery scope early so each project can move forward transparently.

description.zh: 从小型冲压端子到钣金柜体，以一致的项目逻辑管理不同结构件。
description.en: A consistent project approach across small stamped terminals and larger sheet metal cabinets.

description.zh: 在生产前识别需要确认的成形、孔位、折弯、连接和表面问题。
description.en: Identify forming, hole, bend, joining and finish questions before production begins.

description.zh: 以中英文内容、清晰资料清单和结构化询盘流程服务跨境项目沟通。
description.en: Bilingual content, clear information checklists and a structured inquiry flow for cross-border project communication.

title.zh: 帮助采购与工程团队更高效地准备项目
title.en: Practical Guidance for Better-Prepared Manufacturing Projects

intro.zh: 内容围绕图纸准备、工艺选择、表面处理和询价资料展开，避免泛化宣传。
intro.en: Content focuses on drawing preparation, process selection, finishing and RFQ information rather than generic promotion.

title.zh: 冲压还是激光切割：如何为钣金零件选择起始工艺
title.en: Stamping or Laser Cutting: Choosing a Starting Process for Sheet Metal Parts

excerpt.zh: 从数量、结构重复性、模具投入、变更频率和后续折弯装配角度比较两种工艺。
excerpt.en: Compare the two processes through quantity, feature repeatability, tooling investment, change frequency and downstream bending or assembly.

heading.en: Start with the Part and Project Stage

body.zh: 早期验证和设计仍在变化时，激光切割通常更便于快速调整；结构稳定并出现重复需求后，可以进一步评估冲压或连续模方案。
body.en: When design validation is early and changes remain likely, laser cutting is usually easier to adjust. Once geometry is stable and demand repeats, stamping or progressive tooling can be evaluated.

heading.en: Do Not Compare Unit Price Alone

body.zh: 工艺选择还应考虑模具投入、材料利用、操作次数、变更成本、后续折弯以及检验方式。
body.en: Process selection should also consider tooling investment, material utilization, operation count, change cost, downstream bending and inspection approach.

body.zh: 提供相同版本的图纸、预估数量、材料和表面要求，才能让不同制造方案在一致边界下比较。
body.en: Use the same drawing revision, estimated quantity, material and finish requirements so alternative manufacturing routes can be compared on equal terms.

title.zh: 钣金机箱询价前的结构检查清单
title.en: A Structural Checklist Before Requesting a Sheet Metal Enclosure Quote

excerpt.zh: 确认面板开孔、折弯方向、通风、安装件、门盖关系和外观面，可减少后续反复。
excerpt.en: Confirm panel openings, bend directions, ventilation, hardware, door relationships and cosmetic surfaces to reduce later revisions.

body.zh: 标明电路板、模块、导轨、门体和外部接口所依赖的基准，避免仅以外形尺寸表达装配关系。
body.en: Identify the datums used by circuit boards, modules, rails, doors and external interfaces rather than relying only on overall dimensions.

body.zh: 明确哪些表面可见、哪些区域需要防刮或纹理一致，以及接地点或配合面是否允许覆盖表面处理。
body.en: Identify visible surfaces, areas requiring scratch protection or finish consistency, and whether grounding or mating surfaces may be coated.

body.zh: 压铆螺母、螺柱、铰链、把手和紧固件应在图纸或BOM中明确，便于评估安装空间和工序。
body.en: PEM-style hardware, studs, hinges, handles and fasteners should be defined in the drawing or BOM so installation space and operations can be reviewed.

title.zh: 如何在功能、外观与装配之间选择金属表面处理
title.en: Selecting a Metal Finish Across Function, Appearance and Assembly

excerpt.zh: 表面处理不仅是颜色选择，还会影响接地、配合、边缘覆盖、包装与外观验收。
excerpt.en: Finishing is more than color; it affects grounding, fit, edge coverage, packing and cosmetic acceptance.

body.zh: 说明室内或室外、清洁频率、接触介质、温度条件和可见程度，制造方才能协助梳理适合的处理方向。
body.en: State indoor or outdoor use, cleaning frequency, contact media, temperature conditions and visibility so suitable finishing routes can be discussed.

heading.en: Mark Areas That Must Remain Uncoated

body.zh: 接地点、导电接触区、螺纹、精密配合面和焊接区域应在图纸中明确是否需要遮蔽。
body.en: Grounding points, conductive contacts, threads, close-fitting surfaces and weld areas should clearly indicate whether masking is required.

body.zh: 颜色、光泽、纹理、挂点位置和允许的轻微差异应尽量通过样板或明确标准沟通。
body.en: Color, gloss, texture, rack-mark locations and acceptable minor variation should be communicated through samples or clear criteria where possible.

title.zh: 一份高效五金件询价资料应包含什么
title.en: What an Effective Custom Metal Parts RFQ Should Include

excerpt.zh: 完整资料能缩短问题往返，并让报价、工艺和交付边界更加清楚。
excerpt.en: Complete information reduces question cycles and makes quotation, process and delivery scope clearer.

body.zh: 建议提供二维图、三维模型、材料、表面要求、关键特征、装配用途和版本信息。
body.en: Provide a 2D drawing, 3D model, material, finish, critical features, assembly use and revision information where available.

body.zh: 说明样件数量、预计批量、目标时间、包装需求和交付地区，以便形成合理的项目边界。
body.en: State sample quantity, expected production quantity, target timing, packing needs and delivery region to define a practical project scope.

body.zh: 若材料、表面或局部结构允许替代，应明确标注，便于制造评审时提出可执行建议。
body.en: If material, finish or local geometry may be adjusted, mark those items clearly so executable alternatives can be discussed during manufacturing review.
